```{r setup}
library(ggplot2)
run <- oaireport::load_results()$default
colours <- oaireport::brief_colours
assumption <- function(key) run$assumptions$assumptions[[key]]$value
num <- function(x, digits = 2) sub("^-", "\u2212", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits, big.mark = ","))
count <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "d", big.mark = ",")
wave <- function(x) sprintf("%02d", as.integer(x))
pval <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "–", ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)))

GROUPS <- c(step = "Yes, step walker", not = "Yes, not a step walker", no = "No")
comparisons <- assumption("discordance.comparisons")
COMP <- c(primary = "Primary: 96-month item, step bouts",
          counts_mv = "Replication: 96-month item, MV bouts",
          pase48 = "Replication: 48-month PASE walking, step bouts")
COMP_SHORT <- c(primary = "Primary", counts_mv = "Item vs MV bouts", pase48 = "PASE 48 mo")
stopifnot(setequal(names(comparisons), names(COMP)))
bands <- assumption("discordance.smd_bands")
alpha <- assumption("discordance.trend_alpha")
kl_rule <- assumption("discordance.kl_coverage_gap")
visit_months <- c("00" = "0", "01" = "12", "03" = "24", "05" = "36", "06" = "48", "08" = "72", "10" = "96")

# Measures that define the groups are context, not findings: the same rule as
# discordance.render_markdown (discordance.DEFINING, plus discordance.self_report_context for
# the comparisons whose self-report is PASE).
DEFINING <- c("steps", "mv_min")
defining <- function(comparison) {
  pase <- startsWith(comparisons[[comparison]][[1]], "pase")
  c(DEFINING, if (pase) unlist(assumption("discordance.self_report_context")))
}

# KL caveat: the same rule as discordance.coverage_gaps, from the published (masked) shares.
# A masked share sits next to full coverage, so it is skipped; no usable visit fails closed.
klc <- run$discordance_kl_coverage
kl_flag <- vapply(names(COMP), function(cmp) {
  a <- klc[klc$comparison == cmp & klc$group == GROUPS[["step"]], c("visit", "share")]
  b <- klc[klc$comparison == cmp & klc$group == GROUPS[["not"]], c("visit", "share")]
  g <- merge(a, b, by = "visit")
  d <- abs(g$share.x - g$share.y)
  !any(is.finite(d)) || max(d, na.rm = TRUE) > kl_rule
}, logical(1))

LABELS <- c(
  bmi = "BMI", comorbidity = "Comorbidity count", sf12_physical = "SF-12 physical",
  sf12_mental = "SF-12 mental", cesd = "CES-D", pace_20m = "20-m walk pace",
  walk_400m_time = "400-m walk time", employed = "Employed",
  womac_pain = "WOMAC pain", womac_function = "WOMAC function", womac_walk = "WOMAC walking pain",
  frequent_pain_any = "Frequent knee pain", kl_worse = "KL grade (worse knee)",
  replaced_any = "Knee replaced", koos_sport = "KOOS sport/recreation",
  total = "PASE total", total_minus_walking = "PASE total less walking",
  walking_any = "PASE any walking", hours_5plus = "PASE walking 5+ h/wk",
  sitting_long = "PASE long sitting", light_sport = "PASE light sport",
  moderate_sport = "PASE moderate sport", strenuous_sport = "PASE strenuous sport",
  muscle = "PASE muscle strength", light_housework = "Light housework",
  heavy_housework = "Heavy housework", home_repairs = "Home repairs", yard = "Yard work",
  garden = "Gardening", caring = "Caring for others", work_active = "Active work",
  age = "Age at 48 mo", age0 = "Age at baseline", sex = "Female", race = "Race",
  education = "Education", income = "Income", married = "Married", subcohort = "Subcohort",
  site = "Site", amount_years = "Item: years walked", amount_months = "Item: months a year",
  amount_times = "Item: times a week", valid_days = "Valid device days",
  wear_hr = "Device wear hours/day", steps = "Steps/day", mv_min = "MV minutes/day",
  season = "Device season", weekend_share = "Weekend share of device days"
)
lab <- function(m) ifelse(m %in% names(LABELS), LABELS[m], m)
AREAS <- c(activity = "Activity", health = "Health", knee = "Knee", demographic = "Demographic",
           item_amount = "Item amount", device = "Device week")
WINDOWS <- c(level_06 = "Level at 48 mo", change_00_06 = "Change 0 to 48 mo",
             change_06_10 = "Change 48 to 96 mo", fixed = "Fixed")

flag <- function(x) as.logical(toupper(as.character(x)))  # "true"/"false" from the CSVs
scr <- run$discordance_screen
scr$censored <- flag(scr$censored)
scr$area_lab <- factor(AREAS[scr$area], levels = AREAS)
scr$window_lab <- factor(WINDOWS[scr$window], levels = WINDOWS)
scr$label <- lab(scr$measure)
scr$is_defining <- mapply(function(c, m) m %in% defining(c), scr$comparison, scr$measure)
main <- scr[!scr$censored, ]
flow <- run$discordance_flow
tr <- run$discordance_trends
tr$visit <- wave(tr$visit)
tr$censored <- flag(tr$censored)
```

```{r numbers}
persons <- function(cmp, g) flow$persons[flow$comparison == cmp & flow$group == GROUPS[[g]]]
leads <- main[main$band == "lead" & !main$is_defining &
                !(kl_flag[main$comparison] & main$measure == "kl_worse"), ]
n_leads <- table(factor(leads$comparison, levels = names(COMP)))
n_change_leads <- sum(leads$window %in% c("change_00_06", "change_06_10"))
holm_hits <- function(cmp, cens) {
  x <- tr[tr$comparison == cmp & tr$censored == cens & !is.na(tr$p_interaction_holm) &
            tr$p_interaction_holm < alpha & !(tr$measure %in% defining(cmp)) &
            !(kl_flag[[cmp]] & tr$measure == "kl_worse"), ]
  unique(x$measure)
}
hits_main <- lapply(setNames(names(COMP), names(COMP)), holm_hits, cens = FALSE)
hits_cens <- lapply(setNames(names(COMP), names(COMP)), holm_hits, cens = TRUE)
hit_text <- function(cmp) {
  h <- hits_main[[cmp]]
  if (!length(h)) return("none")
  p <- vapply(h, function(m) tr$p_interaction_holm[tr$comparison == cmp & !tr$censored & tr$measure == m][1], 0)
  paste0(lab(h), " (Holm p ", pval(p), ")", collapse = ", ")
}
```

**The question.** Among people who say they walk for exercise, how do those whose device week shows step walking ("`r GROUPS[["step"]]`") differ from those whose device week does not ("`r GROUPS[["not"]]`")? People who say they do not walk ("`r GROUPS[["no"]]`") are shown for reference in stage 1 and are not modelled.

**How to read the two groups.** The self-report and the device may capture different aspects of walking: the item asks about walking for exercise over years, the device records one or two weeks of steps at the hip. A difference between the groups describes who they are. It does not say which source is right.

**Stage 1** gives a standardized mean difference (SMD, "`r GROUPS[["not"]]`" minus "`r GROUPS[["step"]]`", pooled SD, bootstrap 95% CI) for each measure: its level at 48 months, its change from baseline to 48 months and from 48 to 96 months, and fixed measures. Reading bands, fixed before computing: |SMD| below `r bands$small` negligible, `r bands$small`–`r bands$lead` small, `r bands$lead` or more a **lead**. Leads point to measures worth a closer look; they are not tests, and there are no p-values. **Stage 2** follows each time-varying measure over seven visits with a model adjusted for baseline age and sex, and asks whether the gap between the two "Yes" groups changes across visits (group × visit test, Holm-adjusted across measures).

**In brief.** Stage 1 finds `r n_leads[["primary"]]` leads in the primary comparison (`r n_leads[["counts_mv"]]` and `r n_leads[["pase48"]]` in the two replications), `r if (n_change_leads == 0) "all" else "almost all"` in the level at 48 months or in fixed measures; the changes over time differ little. Stage 2 finds that, after Holm, the gap changes across visits for no measure in the primary comparison; in the replications for `r hit_text("counts_mv")` (item against MV bouts) and `r hit_text("pase48")` (PASE). With replaced knees censored, no knee measure passes in any comparison. So the groups differ mainly in where they stand, not in how they change.

# The groups

```{r tab-flow}
tab <- data.frame(
  Comparison = c(primary = "Primary: item, step bouts", counts_mv = "Item, MV bouts",
                 pase48 = "PASE 48 mo, step bouts")[names(COMP)],
  `Device week` = vapply(comparisons, function(x) if (x[[3]] == "mean") "Mean of 48/72 mo" else paste0(visit_months[[x[[3]]]], " mo"), ""),
  step = vapply(names(COMP), function(c) count(persons(c, "step")), ""),
  not = vapply(names(COMP), function(c) count(persons(c, "not")), ""),
  no = vapply(names(COMP), function(c) count(persons(c, "no")), ""),
  total = vapply(names(COMP), function(c) count(sum(flow$persons[flow$comparison == c])), ""),
  check.names = FALSE
)
names(tab)[3:6] <- c(unname(GROUPS), "All")
knitr::kable(tab, row.names = FALSE, align = "llrrrr")
```

**Item:** the 96-month walking-for-exercise item. **PASE:** any walking (PASE item 2) at 48 months. **Device week:** the mean over a person's valid 48- and 72-month weeks, or the 48-month week alone. A device walker has a bout on at least 2 days a week: 10 or more minutes at 100 or more steps a minute (step bouts), or at the release's MV cut-point (MV bouts). The groups use the same self-report coding as the agreement analysis: a "yes" without an amount counts as not walking, and missing answers are excluded, so the primary groups match the 2 × 2 table of the item against step walking. A measure's 48-month value comes from the nearest clinic visit holding it, within one scheduled visit (the visits used are in discordance_screen.csv); changes use the same rule at each end.

# Stage 1: the primary comparison

```{r fig-forest-tv, fig.height = 8.4, fig.cap = paste0("Primary comparison, time-varying measures: SMD (95% CI), \"", GROUPS[["not"]], "\" minus \"", GROUPS[["step"]], "\". Shaded: |SMD| < ", bands$small, " (negligible); dashed lines at ±", bands$lead, "; filled points: leads. Binary measures are compared as shares at 48 months and as mean change over time. Knee measures: worse knee, KL grade 4 kept after a knee replacement.")}
f <- main[main$comparison == "primary" & main$window != "fixed", ]
f$label <- factor(f$label, levels = rev(sort(unique(f$label))))
forest <- function(d, colour_by = NULL, values = NULL, ncol_free = TRUE) {
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(smd, label)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = -bands$small, xmax = bands$small, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = colours[["tint"]]) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-bands$lead, bands$lead), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.3)
  if (is.null(colour_by)) {
    p <- p + geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = smd_lo, xmax = smd_hi, shape = band == "lead"),
                             colour = colours[["navy"]], size = 0.32, linewidth = 0.45) +
      scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 1, `TRUE` = 16), guide = "none")
  } else {
    p <- p + geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = smd_lo, xmax = smd_hi, colour = .data[[colour_by]]),
                             position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 0.22, linewidth = 0.45) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = values, name = NULL)
  }
  p + labs(x = "SMD (95% CI)", y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9.5) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey93"),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0), strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
          panel.spacing.x = unit(0.9, "lines"), legend.position = "top")
}
forest(f) +
  facet_grid(area_lab ~ window_lab, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-0.5, -0.2, 0, 0.2, 0.5))
```

```{r fig-forest-fixed, fig.height = 4.0, fig.cap = local({ ctx <- main[main$comparison == "primary" & main$is_defining, ]; paste0("Primary comparison, fixed measures: SMD (95% CI). Categorical measures (race, education, income, subcohort, site, season and the item's amounts) have an unsigned SMD. Filled points: leads. Steps and MV minutes define the groups and are left out (SMD ", paste0(lab(ctx$measure), " ", num(ctx$smd), collapse = ", "), "). Device measures are over the mean of valid waves.") })}
g <- main[main$comparison == "primary" & main$window == "fixed" & !main$is_defining, ]
g$label <- factor(g$label, levels = rev(sort(unique(g$label))))
forest(g) +
  facet_grid(area_lab ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-0.5, -0.2, 0, 0.2, 0.5))
```

```{r primary-text}
pl <- leads[leads$comparison == "primary", ]
tv_lead <- pl[pl$window == "level_06", ]
ch_lead <- pl[pl$window %in% c("change_00_06", "change_06_10"), ]
top <- function(d, k = 4) { d <- d[order(-abs(d$smd)), ][seq_len(min(k, nrow(d))), ]; paste0(lab(d$measure), " (", num(d$smd), ")", collapse = ", ") }
```

At 48 months, "`r GROUPS[["not"]]`" walk the 400 m more slowly and have a slower 20-m pace, higher BMI, a lower SF-12 physical score and more knee symptoms than "`r GROUPS[["step"]]`" (largest: `r top(tv_lead)`). Their values usually sit between "`r GROUPS[["step"]]`" and "`r GROUPS[["no"]]`". `r if (nrow(ch_lead)) paste0("Changes reaching a lead: ", top(ch_lead, 10), ".") else "No change from baseline to 48 months, or from 48 to 96 months, reaches a lead."` Among fixed measures, education, race and the item's own amounts (how many years, months a year and times a week) differ most, and "`r GROUPS[["step"]]`" wore the device longer each day.

# Stage 1: replications alongside the primary

```{r tab-leads}
key <- unique(leads[, c("measure", "window", "area")])
key <- key[order(match(key$window, names(WINDOWS)), match(key$area, names(AREAS)), key$measure), ]
cell <- function(cmp, m, w) {
  r <- main[main$comparison == cmp & main$measure == m & main$window == w, ]
  if (nrow(r) && r$is_defining) return("(defines groups)")
  if (!nrow(r) || is.na(r$smd)) return("–")
  s <- num(r$smd)
  if (r$band == "lead" && !(kl_flag[[cmp]] && m == "kl_worse")) paste0("**", s, "**") else s
}
lt <- data.frame(
  Measure = lab(key$measure),
  Window = unname(WINDOWS[key$window]),
  Primary = mapply(cell, "primary", key$measure, key$window),
  `Item vs MV bouts` = mapply(cell, "counts_mv", key$measure, key$window),
  `PASE 48 mo` = mapply(cell, "pase48", key$measure, key$window),
  check.names = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(lt, row.names = FALSE, align = "llrrr")
```

The table lists every measure that is a lead (|SMD| ≥ `r bands$lead`, bold) in at least one comparison, with its SMD in each. Categorical SMDs are unsigned. –: not available (the item's amounts do not apply to the PASE comparison). Steps, MV minutes, and in the PASE comparison its own walking items, define the groups and are not listed as leads.

```{r rep-text}
only_rep <- setdiff(unique(leads$measure[leads$comparison != "primary"]), unique(leads$measure[leads$comparison == "primary"]))
```

The replications point the same way as the primary comparison, often more strongly when the device walker is defined by MV bouts. `r if (length(only_rep)) paste0("Leads seen only in a replication: ", paste(lab(only_rep), collapse = ", "), ".") else ""`

# Stage 2: trajectories

```{r trend-select}
tv_measures <- unique(main$measure[main$window == "level_06"])
pick <- function(cmp) {
  h <- hits_main[[cmp]]
  if (length(h)) return(list(measures = h, why = paste0("Holm p < ", alpha)))
  s <- main[main$comparison == cmp & main$window == "level_06" & !main$is_defining &
              !is.na(main$smd) & !(kl_flag[[cmp]] & main$measure == "kl_worse"), ]
  s <- s[order(-abs(s$smd)), ]
  list(measures = head(s$measure, 6),
       why = paste0("no measure has Holm p < ", alpha, "; the 6 largest |SMD| at 48 months are shown"))
}
sel <- lapply(setNames(names(COMP), names(COMP)), pick)
trend_rows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(sel), function(cmp) {
  d <- tr[tr$comparison == cmp & !tr$censored & tr$measure %in% sel[[cmp]]$measures, ]
  d$why <- sel[[cmp]]$why
  d
}))
trend_rows$months <- as.numeric(visit_months[trend_rows$visit])
trend_rows$ref <- ifelse(trend_rows$scale == "or", 1, 0)
trend_rows$panel <- paste0(lab(trend_rows$measure), "\n",
                           ifelse(trend_rows$scale == "or", "odds ratio", "difference"),
                           ", Holm p ", pval(trend_rows$p_interaction_holm))
trend_plot <- function(d, ncol) {
  ggplot(d, aes(months, estimate)) +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = ref), colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), fill = colours[["muted"]], alpha = 0.45) +
    geom_line(colour = colours[["navy"]], linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(colour = colours[["navy"]], size = 1.3) +
    facet_wrap(~panel, scales = "free_y", ncol = ncol) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 24, 48, 72, 96)) +
    labs(x = "Months from baseline", y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9.5) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0))
}
```

For each time-varying measure, a model over visits 0 to 96 months (a linear mixed model with a random intercept for continuous measures; a GEE with exchangeable correlation for 0/1 measures), adjusted for baseline age and sex, gives "`r GROUPS[["not"]]`" against "`r GROUPS[["step"]]`" at each visit: a difference, or an odds ratio. The group × visit test asks whether that gap differs across visits. Its p is Holm-adjusted across measures within each comparison and knee-replacement rule.

```{r fig-trends-primary, fig.height = 4.6, fig.cap = paste0("Primary comparison: adjusted gap, \"", GROUPS[["not"]], "\" against \"", GROUPS[["step"]], "\", at each visit (95% CI). Selection: ", sel$primary$why, ", so these are the largest gaps, not measures whose gap changes. Grey line: no gap.")}
trend_plot(trend_rows[trend_rows$comparison == "primary", ], ncol = 3)
```

```{r fig-trends-rep, fig.height = 2.6, fig.cap = paste0("Replications: adjusted gap at each visit (95% CI) for the measures with Holm p < ", alpha, " (", paste0(COMP_SHORT[c("counts_mv", "pase48")], ": ", vapply(c("counts_mv", "pase48"), function(c) if (length(hits_main[[c]])) paste(lab(hits_main[[c]]), collapse = ", ") else paste0("none; ", sel[[c]]$why), ""), collapse = "; "), "). Grey line: no gap.")}
rep <- trend_rows[trend_rows$comparison != "primary", ]
rep$panel <- paste0(COMP_SHORT[rep$comparison], ": ", rep$panel)
trend_plot(rep, ncol = 2)
```

The gaps in these panels are steady more than changing: where a measure differs at 48 months it already differed at baseline, by a similar amount. The two measures that pass Holm in the replications widen slowly over time.

# Sensitivity: replaced knees censored

```{r fig-sens, fig.height = 3.4, fig.cap = paste0("Primary comparison, knee-level measures: SMD (95% CI) with a replaced knee kept as KL grade 4 (main analysis) and with the replaced knee censored from its replacement visit on (sensitivity). Dashed lines at ±", bands$lead, ".")}
k <- scr[scr$comparison == "primary" & scr$measure %in% scr$measure[scr$censored], ]
k$rule <- factor(ifelse(k$censored, "Replaced knee censored", "KL 4 after replacement"),
                 levels = c("KL 4 after replacement", "Replaced knee censored"))
k$label <- factor(k$label, levels = rev(sort(unique(k$label))))
forest(k, "rule", c(colours[["navy"]], colours[["pase"]])) +
  facet_wrap(~window_lab, nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-0.2, 0, 0.2))
```

```{r tab-stage2}
s2 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(COMP), function(cmp) do.call(rbind, lapply(c(FALSE, TRUE), function(cens) {
  d <- tr[tr$comparison == cmp & tr$censored == cens, ]
  per <- d[!duplicated(d$measure), ]
  fitted <- per[!is.na(per$p_interaction_holm), ]
  hits <- if (cens) hits_cens[[cmp]] else hits_main[[cmp]]
  data.frame(Comparison = COMP_SHORT[[cmp]],
             `Knee replacement` = if (cens) "Replaced knee censored" else "KL 4 after replacement",
             `Measures tested` = paste0(nrow(fitted), " of ", nrow(per)),
             `Smallest Holm p` = pval(min(fitted$p_interaction_holm)),
             `Holm p < 0.05` = if (length(hits)) paste(lab(hits), collapse = ", ") else "none",
             check.names = FALSE)
}))))
knitr::kable(s2, row.names = FALSE, align = "llrrl")
```

The table gives the stage-2 group × visit test by comparison and knee-replacement rule. The censored rule refits only the knee-level measures. A measure whose model did not converge is not tested.

Censoring replaced knees moves the knee-level SMDs very little, and no knee-level trajectory passes Holm under either rule.

# KL-grade coverage

```{r kl-text}
kl_any <- any(kl_flag)
```

`r if (kl_any) paste0("**KL coverage caveat.** In ", paste(COMP_SHORT[kl_flag], collapse = ", "), ", the share of people with a KL reading differs between the two \"Yes\" groups by more than ", 100 * kl_rule, " percentage points at some visit (discordance_kl_coverage.csv), so KL grade is reported there with this caveat and is not counted as a lead or listed in stage 2.") else paste0("The share of people with a KL reading stays within ", 100 * kl_rule, " percentage points between the two \"Yes\" groups at every visit in every comparison, so KL grade is read like any other measure. Coverage falls after 48 months in all groups (discordance_kl_coverage.csv).")`

Small cells are suppressed in the results files before this report reads them. Full tables: discordance_screen.csv and discordance_trends.csv.
